limitations: Pattern scan is a bounded heuristic, not proof that secrets cannot exist. Matches are paths/counts only; no credential text is emitted.
Archives are read without extraction; members up to64MiB and cumulative256MiB per archive scanned. Nested archives are inventoried as member bytes but not recursively unpacked.
Changes created after this timestamp need a final incremental publication scan.
Ignored raw evidence requires explicit inclusion or a versioned archive manifest. Ignored cache/environment files must remain excluded.
